`1355732e` was **fully green on the hosted gate** (all 8 parts, `gate`, `report`,
`warranted`, `memory` and `still-frame`, 03:30:58Z) — but by then `dev` had moved and

| merged `dev` | conflicts | how |
|---|---|---|
| `19910ff1` (T-3041, T-1934, T-3363, T-2383 + folds) | 5 | registries **row by row**; the three append-only docs dev-whole + this branch's block after; three generated files re-derived |

**The registries were audited, not trusted.** On each lap, every row of
`assets/manifest.json` (7,559), `assets/manifest.web.json` (1,036) and
`assets/manifest.versions.json` (56) was compared across merge-base / dev / branch:
the two sides' changed sets **never intersected**, each side kept its own values, and

`data/liberties.json` at 996 — the exact unions, none duplicated. No geometry, record

`fort_structure` producer or `generators/blender.pin`, and none touches

**The whole source gate, hosted — the `gate` check itself, not only `report`/`warranted`:**

| check | result |
|---|---|
| `gate part 1/8` … `gate part 8/8` | **all 8 success** |
